## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `content`: Adding/updating blog posts or projects
- [ ] `refactor`: Code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature
- [ ] `style`: UI/Tailwind styling changes
- [ ] `chore`: Build process, dependencies, or configuration updates

## Checklist

- [ ] Code builds and runs locally without errors (`npm run dev` / `npm run build`)
- [ ] No linting or TypeScript compiler warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow the Conventional Commits specification
